_why: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which CoA roles each money-posting feature flag needs. Read by BOTH the CI guard (scripts/verify-posting-flags-require-bound-accounts.mjs) and the runtime readiness endpoint (apps/backend/src/accounting/coa-roles/routes.ts). Two copies drift — that is exactly how the local and CI branch-freshness gates ended up disagreeing (TOOL-F01, 2026-07-30). One file, two consumers.
_rule: A flag ABSENT from this map is a flag NOBODY checks. On 2026-07-30 this map held only 6 flags, and a migration armed three posters whose roles have zero bindings on prod — every one of them throws CoaRoleResolutionError on first use. Add the flag here the moment a poster is written.
_roles_are_read_from_the_poster: Each role list is taken from the poster's actual resolveRoleAccount() call sites, not inferred from names. Grepping for role-shaped strings produced WRONG names once already.
